activities.name: Kruger game viewing
activities.note: the park is open all year; what changes is whether you can see through the bush

windows.reason: the dry winter: animals concentrate at the perennial waterholes and the thinned vegetation makes them visible. Mornings can drop below 5 °C, afternoons reach the low twenties
the wet months — thick green bush, dispersed water and much harder sightings

activities.name: Southern right whales, Hermanus
activities.note: the whales are elsewhere in the Southern Ocean the rest of the year

windows.reason: the season runs roughly July to December, with land-based viewing from the Hermanus cliffs among the best anywhere
the edges of the season — first arrivals in June, stragglers into December
